observed_failure.problem: the initial generator reminted surface independently for each responsibility family, so the registered same-surface hostile control was only prose

amendment.surface_rule: for each protected index, all five responsibility families share one opaque surface token
amendment.candidate_order_rule: candidate kind presentation order is keyed only by the shared surface token plus independent order seed, so same-surface hostile cases have identical presentation order
amendment.identity_rule: evaluator world identity remains distinct but is removed from model_payload
